text:
michelle: Quick Q — coordinating Anika's parental plan. She wants to bank 4 weeks to use later, is that allowed? :thinking_face:
oliver: We allow banking up to 6 weeks but it needs manager + people-ops signoff. If it crosses a calendar year there are payroll/benefits implications.
sarah: @michelle also flag FMLA/leave paperwork. Banking changes the LOA dates and sometimes benefits eligibility windows.
michelle: Got it. What is the approval flow? New paperwork or just LOA amendment?
jen: You'll submit an LOA amendment. Internal link: https://redwood.workday/loa_amend. Manager approves in Workday and People Ops signs off.
jen: ```LOA amendment checklist:
- employee request and preferred dates
- weeks to bank/use
- manager approval (Workday)
- people-ops confirmation
- payroll code update if partial/unpaid
```
michelle: Thanks. Also question about phased return — Anika wants 2 mornings / week on-site for 6 weeks before full return. Is that supported? :baby-bottle:
oliver: Yes, we support phased returns as an accommodation. Manager + people-ops coordinate schedule, and we provide template for coverage/backfill and oncall swaps.
sarah: Note: phased/partial days can affect accruals and benefits proration. Payroll needs the exact schedule by the 15th of the month before the pay period.
michelle: Useful. Another on-site ask — lactation room booking + fridge access for breast milk for days she's on-site. How do we get a fridge key and secure storage?
jen: Lactation rooms are bookable via the office desk app. Fridge keys are managed by facilities. I'll add a note to the LOA packet with contacts: facilities@redwood.com.
jen: I'll open a facilities ticket to reserve a drawer and provide pickup instructions for shipping milk if needed.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit amended LOA within 10 business days of request to avoid benefits or payroll delays.
michelle: International nuance — Anika is on H-1B. Any visa implications for banking leave or extended unpaid time?
legal-team: @michelle tagging legal: unpaid extensions can affect visa status. If banking converts paid leave to unpaid extension beyond the authorized period, escalate to legal for visa review.
michelle: OK will escalate if amended plan increases unpaid time. Also, her performance review overlaps with leave. Should we pause?
sarah: For reviews during approved leave we generally either defer the live review or document a written check-in. See performance policy: https://redwood.hr/reviews. Manager should indicate any timeline impacts for promotions.
michelle: Can someone paste the sample manager language for reviews during leave?
jen: Sample: "We will pause the formal review conversation until [date]; the manager will provide a written summary of performance areas and any interim goals. Promotion timelines may be adjusted case-by-case." Feel free to copy/edit.
michelle: Thanks all. I'll gather Anika's preferred dates and submit the amendment. I'll cc facilities for the fridge/drawer.
legal-team: Ping us early if unpaid leave changes or visa scope needs updating.
facilities: We're on it — opening ticket for fridge drawer and lactation-room key pickup.
michelle: Appreciate it everyone :heart:
